params.name: Navigate
params.note: Who follows an Href on a plain click: "router" (default), "host" (OnNavigate is a notification and nothing navigates, so your handler uses NavigationManager) or "none" (the browser follows the address). It is the default for the items with an Href that set none.

params.name: WrapLabels
params.note: Let long item labels wrap onto several lines instead of an ellipsis.
